# **Ordnungsbussenstatistik Kanton Thurgau ab 2023**

[Link to dataset on data.tg.ch](https://data.tg.ch/explore/dataset/djs-kpo-11/information/)

## Description

<p>Jährliche Kennzahlen der Ordnungsbussenzentrale (OBZ) des Kantons Thurgau zu Geschwindigkeitskontrollen, Ordnungsbussen, Strafanzeigen sowie zu finanziellen Kenngrössen (Ertrag, Debitorenstand) für die Jahre ab 2023.</p><p></p><p>Datenquelle: Kantonspolizei Kanton Thurgau</p>

## Load Packages

Every dataset (csv and geodata) on [data.tg.ch](https://data.tg.ch/pages/start/) can be retrieved with the **tgAPI** package. You can download it via [GitHub](https://github.com/ogdtg/tgAPI). Please note that the package has some dependencies, which can result in a lengthy installation process. Therefore, we do not recommend installing the package directly in Google Colab. However, if you intend to run this code on your local machine, we strongly recommend installing the tgAPI package.

```{r}
library(httr)
library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)
# library(remotes)
# remotes::install.github("ogdtg/tgAPI")

```


## Download Data


```{r}
# Download the Dataset via API
res <- httr::GET("https://data.tg.ch/api/explore/v2.0/catalog/datasets/djs-kpo-11/exports/json")
data <- res$content %>%
  rawToChar() %>%
  jsonlite::fromJSON()

# Use tgAPI
# data <- tgAPI::get_dataset("djs-kpo-11")

head(data)

```


## Explore Metadata

```{r}

res <- httr::GET("https://data.tg.ch/api/explore/v2.0/catalog/datasets/djs-kpo-11")
metadata <- res$content %>%
  rawToChar() %>%
  jsonlite::fromJSON()

# Fields name
cat("\nFields name")
metadata$dataset$fields$name

# Fields description
cat("\nFields description")
metadata$dataset$fields$description

# Fields data type
cat("\nFields data type")
metadata$dataset$fields$type

```
